features.name: The Royal Exchange, London
features.official_source_evidence: The official Royal Exchange domain presents the building's shopping and dining destination. Current authoritative property reporting also identifies occupied luxury retail, restaurant and bar space within the Royal Exchange.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property remains supported. Exact building footprint and separation from upper-floor office interests remain pending.

features.name: The Scalpel / 52 Lime Street
features.official_source_evidence: KPF identifies 52 Lime Street, known as The Scalpel, as its London tower project. Published City planning and building records consistently identify the address and principal office use.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is supported. Limited restaurant and retail space does not displace the dominant office classification, but exact tower footprint remains pending.

features.name: Ham House and Garden
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Ham House as a 17th-century Stuart house at Ham Street, Ham, Richmond, Surrey TW10 7RS.
features.classification_finding: The standalone-house identity is strong, but the current Detached Home taxonomy needs review because the asset is a historic visitor property rather than an ordinary occupied residential dwelling.

features.name: The Capston / Embassy Gardens
features.official_source_evidence: The official development site describes The Capston as 247 prime riverside residences on the south bank of the Thames and publishes the sales-gallery address at 10 Viaduct Gardens, London SW11 7BW.
features.classification_finding: Apartment Building is directly supported. The sales gallery must not be treated as the residential building footprint; exact residential-block geometry remains pending.

features.name: Fenton House and Garden, Hampstead
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Fenton House as a handsome 17th-century house at Hampstead Grove, Hampstead, London NW3 6SP.
features.classification_finding: Standalone-house identity and address are strong, but the current visitor-heritage use requires a taxonomy decision before preserving Detached Home as a production property type.

features.name: DP World London Gateway Logistics Park
features.official_source_evidence: DP World identifies London Gateway as one of Europe's largest port-centric logistics parks and describes serviced land plots, pre-built warehouses and built-to-suit facilities.
features.classification_finding: The tracked entity is a multi-building logistics park rather than one Industrial Unit. It also appears to duplicate DPT_WEB_VERIFIED_LONDON_GATEWAY_LOGISTICS_022 at entity level. Select a specific warehouse or reject/merge the duplicate before geometry binding.
